Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('work/owner.rar').read_bytes()
print(len(b))
for i in range(0,len(b),16): print(f'{i:04x}:', ' '.join(f'{x:02x}' for x in b[i:i+16]), ''.join(chr(x) if 32<=x<127 else '.' for x in b[i:i+16]))

def read_var(pos):
    res=0; shift=0; start=pos
    while True:
        v=b[pos]; pos+=1
        res |= (v&0x7f)<<shift
        if not v&0x80: break
        shift+=7
    return res,pos,pos-start
pos=8
blk=0
while pos<len(b):
    blk+=1
    crc=int.from_bytes(b[pos:pos+4],'little'); pos+=4
    raw,pos2,l=read_var(pos)
    hdr_start=pos
    hdr_size=raw+l
    print('block',blk,'at',pos-4,'crc',hex(crc),'raw',raw,'lenvar',l,'hdr_size',hdr_size,'hdrbytes',b[pos:pos+hdr_size].hex())
    p=pos2
    hid,p,_=read_var(p); fl,p,_=read_var(p)
    print(' id flags',hid,hex(fl),'fields start rel',p-pos)
    # jump: header bytes consumed include hdr_size; plus data size if file? We'll parse data size
    q=p
    if hid in (2,3):
        edata=None; dsize=None
        if fl & 1: edata,q,_=read_var(q)
        if fl & 2: dsize,q,_=read_var(q)
        print(' edata dsize',edata,dsize,'q rel',q-pos)
    pos += hdr_size
    if hid in (2,3) and dsize:
        print(' data at',pos,'len',dsize,b[pos:pos+dsize])
        pos += dsize
PY
